steps.name: 1. Discovery Call
steps.desc: We start with a call to understand your brand, goals, audience and what success looks like.

steps.name: 2. Strategy Call
steps.desc: We dive deeper into your objectives and craft the right creative approach.

steps.name: 3. Ideate & Script
steps.desc: We ideate, structure the concept and write a script that brings the idea to life.

steps.name: 4. Shoot
steps.desc: We plan, set up and capture the right footage with precision and creativity.

steps.name: 5. Edit & Design
steps.desc: We edit the video and add motion graphics, sound and polish everything.

steps.name: 6. Review
steps.desc: We send it to you for revision and make sure it's perfect.

steps.name: 7. Deliver
steps.desc: Once approved, we deliver or publish as per your requirements.
